verdict.rationale: The docs state that Grok Build supports any custom model, added through the user-level config file, so non-xAI models can be configured. That is a single thin statement: it gives no provider list, setup details, or in-session model picker. The community mention of multi-provider CLI forks concerns third-party forks, so it neither adds credit nor contradicts the claim. Missing for 10: documented multi-provider configuration (endpoints, keys, provider list), per-session or in-TUI model switching, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Grok supports any custom model. Add it to your user-level config file, `~/.grok/config.toml`
